set.body:
Point 5 final integration gate; sole M1 product completion witness. Depends on saved-state/export and its full local chain. Repository owner: StoryAtlas integration; producer evidence must be linked to StoryModel goal bd-01M34J9FS10B14WQA309K0P6V8. This task does not perform or certify scientific efficacy/recovery.

Run on a clean exact producer/consumer pair with immutable Intaglio/grakern pins. Producer checkAll is recorded on its merge result; consumer compileAll testAll scalafmtCheckAll app/fastLinkJS, existing edition/shell smoke and the new workspace browser suite run with bound command receipts, totals, exit statuses and named skips. Resolve consumer compiler warnings required by repository policy rather than relabeling warning-bearing output clean. Reuse only evidence whose source inputs and scope are demonstrably unchanged.

End-to-end acceptance on producer-generated WOG plus a second small synthetic text case:
1. Same app.js opens source+recall+mapping without a rebuild; imported and partial/draft authority remain honest.
2. Keyboard-select an untimed unit; every supplied alternative, external value, failure and unavailable evidence is inspectable.
3. Descend to exact permitted source/recall evidence; switch source/matrix/Voyage views and keep semantic identity and independent horizons.
4. Refuse a deliberately foreign bundle with reused IDs/title before rendering. Optional missing features preserve the valid mapping; denied content is absent from DOM, accessibility, tooltip, logs and all exports.
5. Select another precomputed mapping policy without estimator execution; retain correct labels and refuse incompatible joins.
6. Save, reopen and export; independently recover the identical semantic selection, IDs, values/support and policy. Altered artifact digests must refuse replay.
7. Demonstrate keyboard, visible focus, non-color semantics and usable 200-percent zoom on this journey; preserve existing source/static/Voyage regression courts. Do not weaken unrelated static no-script publication.

Archive exact SHAs, generated artifact hashes, independent expected answers, build/browser/test receipts, representative screenshots or traces, named failure/control witnesses, warning/skip disposition and separate cold review. Acceptance fails if any numbered behavior is absent, simulated by an inert mockup, or only inferred from a constructor suite.

After acceptance, close this task with the receipt, close the Atlas M1 container, and reconcile the same receipt in the StoryModel M1 goal. Verify local and foreign issue/artifact identities explicitly; foreign closure is never automatic. No hosted CI success, push, deployment or release is inferred.

M1 does not require automatic scenes/episodes, automatic recall proposition charts, calibrated probabilities, reference-measurement inference, temporal-organization readouts, new corpus admission, structural-channel efficacy comparisons, film playback, autobiographical interviews, virtualization, population views or general chronology. Existing film/release commitments remain on their own lanes. Use redistributable WOG and synthetic fixtures; no participant prose, sealed-test opening, hosted API spend or new remote calls. One implementation writer and one heavy gate at a time; no fleet claims/reservations/candidates.
set.title: [M1] Qualify the complete two-fixture researcher journey
